clips.prompt: A vast, overgrown field of tall, dew-laden grass dominates the scene, stretching toward distant, mist-shrouded hills under a heavy, brooding sky of layered storm clouds. The scene is an arid, sun-baked highway stretching through a semi-industrial desert landscape, flanked by dry scrub, scattered palm trees, and distant rugged mountains under a pale blue sky with soft cumulus clouds; the asphalt road shows wear with faded lane markings, bordered by metal guardrails and concrete barriers. Industrial structures—including large cylindrical silos with red bands, rusted metal towers, and parked black tanker railcars—stand adjacent to the road, contrasting with the natural terrain through their utilitarian steel and concrete materials, weathered textures, and muted greys, ochres, and rust tones. A lone male figure in a light grey short-sleeved shirt and khaki trousers stands centered on the road, his posture neutral, casting a sharp shadow under the bright, high-contrast daylight that emphasizes the dusty atmosphere and gritty realism of the environment.
